basexhome.description: BaseX home directory — root of configuration and data hierarchy.

database_dir.description: Default directory for databases. If omitted, defaults to ${BASEXHOME}/data.

server_port.description: Port used by the BaseX HTTP and REST API server.

http_server.description: Enable or disable the HTTP server.

webapp_server.description: Enable or disable the Web Server UI (BaseX Web UI).

default_parser.description: Default parser: xml, html, text, binary, auto.

html_options.description: List of HTML parser options (e.g., ['method=html', 'nons=true']). Only effective when default_parser=html.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum number of queries to retain in the cache.

disk_index.description: Enable disk-based indexing for large databases.

compression.description: Enable compression of stored XML documents.

log_level.description: Logging level: INFO (default), WARN, ERROR, DEBUG.

use_server.description: If true, signals this is a server configuration — currently only used for conditional comments in template.
